title: Parking pass
passage: How long is this parking permit valid? A. You are permitted to enter. B. Until your checkout time on Friday. C. The parking lot is behind the hotel.
passageZh:
這張停車證有效多久？
A. 你可以進入。
B. 到你星期五退房的時間為止。
C. 停車場在飯店後面。
audioScript: How long is this parking permit valid? A. You are permitted to enter. B. Until your checkout time on Friday. C. The parking lot is behind the hotel.
